Consonantal i

SearchHow we decideRulings

Macrons

Consonantal i

Theme

Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

simple adjective

plain, not elaborate

also plain, basic, simplicity, frugal, simple food, a simple meal

classical

Tac. Germ. 23.1: cibī simplicēs
Hor. C. 1.38.5 (Lewis & Short)
Cic. Caecin. 5: rēs aperta ac simplex (Lewis & Short)

simplex, simplicis

adjective, third declension, one ending

simple, plain, unmixed; uncomplicated

Food, dress or speech with nothing added; also a matter with nothing tangled in it, rēs aperta ac simplex. Of a person, simplex is open and without guile (see direct). “It’s simple”, meaning “it’s easy”, is facile est (see easy).

Other words

  • tenuis, tenue — plain, modest, slender (of food, a table, a way of life)

    adjective, third declension · also used · classical · Hor. C. 2.16.14: mēnsā tenuī; Cic. Tusc. 3.49: tenuem vīctum antefert cōpiōsō (Lewis & Short)

  • frūgī — plain, frugal; of a person, thrifty and sensible

    indeclinable adjective · also used · classical · Mart. 13.31.1: jentācula … frūgī; Ter. Ad. 959: Frūgī homō es

    Properly a dative, “fit for food”, then “serviceable, honest, temperate”; as an adjective it never changes its ending (Lewis & Short, s.v. frūx).

Examples

  • cibī simplicēs, agrestia pōma, recēns fera aut lac concrētum: sine apparātū, sine blandīmentīs expellunt famem

    their food is simple: wild fruit, fresh game or curdled milk; they drive away hunger without fuss and without relishesTac. Germ. 23.1

  • potes apparātius cēnāre apud multōs, nusquam hilarius simplicius incautius

    you can dine more grandly in many houses, but nowhere more merrily, simply and freelyPlin. Ep. 1.15.4

  • sī sine carne volēs jentācula sūmere frūgī, haec tibi Vestīnō dē grege massa venit

    if you want a plain breakfast without meat, here is a cheese for you from a Vestine flockMart. 13.31.1–2

See also easy, direct, basic.
